data.name: Sabeera
data.gender_notes: Sabeera is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman of patience and steadfastness. The name Sabeera carries the meaning “Patient, steadfast” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Sabeera usually hope their child will grow to embody patient, steadfast and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a woman who embodies the strength and determination of a true believer
data.etymology: Sabeera belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Patient, steadfast.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sabeera total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sabeera holds a significant place in Islamic culture. It is derived from the Arabic root word "sabr," which means patience and perseverance. In many Islamic societies, the virtues of patience and steadfastness are highly valued and admired. Thus, a woman named Sabeera would be regarded as a strong, resilient, and admirable sister, mother, wife, or friend. She is someone who possesses a fortitude and endurance that can inspire and uplift those around her.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the name Sabeera is deeply connected to the qualities of patience and resilience, which are essential traits of the believers in Allah. The Prophet Muhammad (Peace Be Upon Him) is recorded to have said: "Patience is from Allah, and victory is from Allah. And if Allah takes away victory from a people, they should still be patient. And if Allah does that to a people, then they have been wronged." A person named Sabeera is encouraged to embody these virtues in her daily life, drawing strength and inspiration from her name, and striving to overcome the trials and tribulations that she may face. She is ultimately reminded that her patience and perseverance will be rewarded not just in this world, but in the next as well.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Patient, steadfast" symbolizes A woman of patience and steadfastness. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Sabeera serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of patient, steadfast.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Sabeera was a prominent female companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Sabeera carried significant weight in that era.

trends: The name Sabeera is popular in the Indian subcontinent.
It is also used in some Arab countries.
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Sabeera remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Layla Sabeera in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Sabeera, which means "Patient, steadfast". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
